title: Mean square of restricted Fourier coefficients
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $J,S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$. For each assignment $z$ of signs outside $J$, form the ambient restriction Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$. Its mean square over uniformly chosen $z$ is $\sum_{T\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\setminus J}\widehat f\bigl((S\cap J)\cup T\bigr)^2$ if $S\subseteq J$, and is $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ and $S$ are subsets of the coordinate set
$f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
